fact_key_rule: A stable entity, fact attributes and effective interval identify one logical fact; new source evidence appends a source_revision_id and never updates the prior row.
as_recorded_rule: Select only a revision whose system_available_at is at or before the observation cutoff.
pre_v4_history: RECONSTRUCTED_CORRECTED; never relabel reconstructed facts as AS_RECORDED.
provider_available_at: NULL when the provider does not expose a reliable availability timestamp.
